verdict.rationale: Docusaurus installs locally with `npx create-docusaurus`. `npm run build` generates static files in the `build` directory, and the `docusaurus serve` command serves them, so users can host the whole product themselves on any static host. Community sources corroborate that it is open source and MIT licensed, and so forkable. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of the open-source license, and an explicit first-party guide for deploying to your own servers rather than the listed third-party hosts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Once it finishes, the static files will be generated within the `build` directory.
Docusaurus provides a [`docusaurus serve`](/docs/cli#docusaurus-serve-sitedir) command for that
while keeping it MIT licensed so the community can fork it if Facebook ever decides to stop maintaining it
The DX is fantastic and it's open source!
